title: Code and data for a controlled study of batch reinforcement learning for stepwise composition of strip-packing heuristic components
description: Python code and data for stepwise composition of classic best-fit-family components with tree-based Fitted Q Iteration: the configurable constructive engine, FQI/Double-DQN training pipelines, pre-registered control arms, all experiment runners, benchmark instances, per-run raw results (CSV), and the trained per-fold models.
